name: markdown-anchoring
body: Markdown is not scanned code. The distributed agent prompts (opencode-suite/agents/*.md) and the root AGENTS.md are prose shipped by `apg init` through the embedded suite in src/main.rs — they have no Function/Struct/File node in the code graph. A solution component covering them must therefore anchor its `implemented-by` edge to the embedding/install Rust (`apg.main`, and the init install path in src/main.rs), NEVER to a `.md` path — a `.md` target would fail write-time as a drift/nonexistent code FQN. This note records that consideration for the `agent-prompt-text` component.
